fn burn(deps:DepsMut,provider:String,liq:Uint128)->Result<Response,ContractError>{let p=deps.api.addr_validate(&provider)?;let total=TOTAL_LP.load(deps.storage)?;let bal=LP_BALANCES.may_load(deps.storage,p.as_str())?.unwrap_or_default();if liq>bal||liq>total{return Err(ContractError::InsufficientLiquidity)};let mut r=RESERVES.load(deps.storage)?;let out0=r.reserve0.multiply_ratio(liq.u128(),total.u128());let out1=r.reserve1.multiply_ratio(liq.u128(),total.u128());r.reserve0=r.reserve0.checked_sub(out0).map_err(StdError::overflow)?;r.reserve1=r.reserve1.checked_sub(out1).map_err(StdError::overflow)?;RESERVES.save(deps.storage,&r)?;LP_BALANCES.save(deps.storage,p.as_str(),&bal.checked_sub(liq).map_err(StdError::overflow)?)?;TOTAL_LP.save(deps.storage,&total.checked_sub(liq).map_err(StdError::overflow)?)?;Ok(Response::new())}
